coverage.reason: Says appointing a principal underwriter 'does not guarantee sales or asset gathering' and that 'the underwriter alone does not determine distribution outcomes.'

Separates the legal/operational distributor role from 'separately contracted marketing' (sales force, wholesaling, advertising) and from intermediary access (wirehouse/RIA/model approvals), and notes that platform packages vary.

rationale: Both required minimums are fully covered. The answer explicitly rejects the central error. Its description of the distributor's operational role (creation/redemption order processing, AP coordination) is broadly consistent with ETF distributor arrangements, so it is not a material falsehood. It does not claim that every sponsor must employ its own sales team. Not citing the Simplify/Foreside example is an omission and does not reduce the grade.
